device_entry.name: Cobolt 06-01 激光器
tags: 显微成像与光学显微实验
device_entry.description: 这是一款紧凑型实验室激光光源，可提供受控的激光输出功率，并支持调制工作模式。它常用于显微成像、荧光激发、光学对准及其他需要稳定激光照明或激发光的实验与仪器系统。
device_entry.description_en: This is a compact laboratory laser source that provides controlled optical output power and supports modulation operating modes. It is commonly used for microscopy, fluorescence excitation, optical alignment, and other experiments or instruments that require stable laser illumination or excitation light.
